title: Snail Shell Eye in Storm
description: A large mechanical snail shell with a prominent green human eye at its center floats amidst turbulent blue ocean waves. The shell is covered in lettered tiles resembling Scrabble pieces while torn book pages and colorful flowers swirl in the stormy air around it.
prompt: A surreal mechanical snail shell ship with a large realistic green human eye at its center, covered in wooden letter tiles like Scrabble pieces, floating in turbulent stormy blue ocean waves with white foam. Torn book pages and colorful flowers float in the wind around it, whimsical yet chaotic atmosphere, intricate details, painterly style.
